dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly for adding Outlit SDK tracking, identity, consent, activation, billing context, and troubleshooting; the instructions match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The guide tells agents to inspect app framework, auth, billing, analytics, and consent signals before changing code, then add SDK setup and tracking. The scope is broad but coherent for an analytics integration.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only SKILL.md, no executable payloads. Installation is disclosed through the Outlit CLI or Skills CLI from the referenced GitHub skill source.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill may add browser and server telemetry, including pageviews, form-submission metadata with sensitive fields removed, email/name identification, and stable fingerprints for native contexts. These are privacy-sensitive but expected for this tracking SDK.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The main persistence is browser visitor storage, queued identity until tracking is enabled, reusable server/native clients, and stable device fingerprints for native tracking. No hidden daemon, privilege escalation, destructive action, or unrelated credential access was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The artifact does describe automatic browser capture and auto-identification; this is central to a tracking SDK and is disclosed, though users should treat it as privacy-sensitive and confirm consent/legal requirements.
[EA2] expected: The consent table allows autoTrack true when no consent requirement is found, while disabling it for detected CMP or EU/privacy signals and explaining immediate visitor storage. This is guidance-worthy but not enough for Review because the behavior is disclosed and purpose-aligned.
llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to add Outlit analytics to an app. Before enabling browser auto-tracking, confirm your consent, privacy notice, and data-processing requirements, especially because the SDK can create visitor storage and link activity to email, name, user ID, customer ID, or device fingerprint.
llm.summary: This is a coherent Outlit tracking integration guide, with privacy-sensitive tracking behavior disclosed and aligned with the skill’s stated purpose.
